title: A mini-spec team and a before-building procedure
source: Or062; the commander's idea file commander/desk/out/ideas/mini-spec.txt
notes: The commander's idea is that a build request is written by a mini-spec team (commander-advocate, done-decider, verification-provider) called by a "before building" procedure, not by the pilot alone. Rq014 was written by the pilot and attacked afterwards by one advocate; the commander let that pass once only (Or062). Needed before the next build request: a roster in team/rosters/, a procedure with its trigger line ("before a build request is written"), and P006 amended so a build request is the team's product. The idea file and ace_mini-spec.txt are on his desk for remix; talk it through with him first (P002).
